bindery-queue.name: Bindery Queue
bindery-queue.description: Build a finishing queue from the bindery list and open tickets.

delivery-today.name: Delivery Today
delivery-today.description: List jobs that should leave today from the delivery log and matching tickets.

due-today.name: Due Today
due-today.description: List tickets due today or overdue, then read each due against the press calendar.

job-board.name: Job Board
job-board.description: Build a board from their ticket sheet: job, customer, qty, stock, proof, due, press, and bindery.

mill-order-vs-stock.name: Mill Order Vs Stock
mill-order-vs-stock.description: Join the mill-order sheet to on-hand stock and flag tickets waiting on paper.

preflight-completeness.name: Preflight Completeness
preflight-completeness.description: Run their checklist only against files in the proof or art folder.

proof-status.name: Proof Status
proof-status.description: List each open ticket's proof type and status, then confirm a matching proof in the folder.

reprint-log.name: Reprint Log
reprint-log.description: List reprint tickets with parent job, qty, and the required reason text.

stock-vs-jobs.name: Stock Vs Jobs
stock-vs-jobs.description: Compare on-hand stock to the pull implied by open tickets. Shortages stay visible.
